book.cover_subtitle: One cell / short and tall holders / M6 adjustable rails
details: One cell: independent short front holder and tall rear holder. Four frames and two rails per holder.
Nominal opening: 335 mm. Rail heights: 37 mm front, 112 mm rear. Row centres: 187 mm.
Print all plastic parts in black. Use the 11 mm nut covers and 11 mm slotted covers.
Cut four M6 threaded rods to 300 mm and deburr the ends. Prepare a 10 mm spanner.
Each rail: one 18 mm M6 coupling nut, one M6 x 25 fully threaded hex bolt and two M6 nuts.
Seat the fixed nut and bolt head in the outer frame recesses. Retain the bolt with an inner nut.
Nominal coupling engagement: rod 5.99 mm; bolt 7 mm. Bolt length is measured under the head.
Measure the actual opening before adjustment. Do not force the cabinet sides apart.
Keep refills strapped. Illustrated front reels are 200 mm diameter x 60 mm wide.
M6 x 300 threaded rod: OOMP record pending. No shortlink is assigned.
AI-generated CAD images and instructions. Errors possible. Physical fit and load capacity untested.

steps.title: Start the short holder
steps.action: Seat two M6 nuts in the first short frame's outer recesses. Thread in two 300 mm rods with their ends flush with the nuts.

steps.title: Fit the first sleeves
steps.action: Slide one 99.67 mm sleeve onto each rod, then fit the second frame.

steps.title: Fit the centre and remaining sleeves
steps.action: Fit two 67.67 mm sleeves, the third frame and two 99.67 mm sleeves. Face the last sleeves' hex pockets toward the couplings.

steps.title: Fit the couplings
steps.action: Insert an M6 coupling nut into each 18 mm housing. Thread each coupling approximately 6 mm onto its rod.

steps.title: Fit the adjusting end
steps.action: Face the final frame's recesses outward. Insert the M6 x 25 hex bolts, add retaining nuts loosely and slide the 11 mm hex covers over them. Thread the bolt tips into the couplings.

steps.title: Adjust and close the rails
steps.action: Set the width to the measured opening, nominally 335 mm. Seat the bolt heads in the outer recesses. Slide the hex covers aside, tighten the retaining nuts against the inner frame face, then replace the covers. Clip the 11 mm slotted covers over the exposed thread, slots downward. Seat the wider end 8 mm over the retaining cover.

steps.action: Seat two M6 nuts in the first tall frame's outer recesses. Thread in two 300 mm rods with their ends flush with the nuts.

readme.title: KALLAX filament holders
readme.summary: 3D-printable holders for storing 3D printer filament in an IKEA KALLAX shelving unit. One cell holds five reels at the front and five strapped filament refills without spools on a raised rear row. This repository includes printable files, editable source and illustrated assembly instructions.
readme.ai_notice: This is an entirely AI-generated coding project. The source code is largely unreadable by humans, but usable generated files are included. It is published so others can use their own AI tools to understand, modify and regenerate the design.
readme.version_description: Four short and four tall frames; four adjustable M6 rails. Five front reels and five rear refills.
readme.installation: Place the tall holder at the rear and the short holder at the front. Seat all feet on the shelf. Load the strapped rear refills, then the five front reels.
